decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already updates the About-page copy to state that every successful primary mint generates a ticket, including random no-code or invalid-code allocation, while excluding secondary-market sales.
A same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ explanations with the primary-mint cardinality, random allocation, and secondary-market exclusion established by the source.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: There should be as many commissions and tickets as mints (excluding secondary market sales), but it seems those sent out at random aren't registering

decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already confirms one randomly allocated $5 commission and one Small Block ticket per successful primary mint while excluding secondary-market sales.
The source reports the system-wide ticket and commission cardinality and a random-allocation registration problem; it does not necessarily require changing the concise landing-page hero tease.
The source does not change the $15 primary-mint split or any allocation amount; random recipient assignment is governed by the separate no-referral reward requirement.
Ticket and commission issuance has no necessary effect on the landing-page book-cover display.
The source concerns commission and ticket generation and registration, not how a selected winner receives or is notified about a prize.
Excluding secondary-market sales from commissions and tickets does not exclude secondary royalties from funding the Small Block pool or change its prize amount, winner count, or draw condition.
The source applies to reward issuance after any successful primary mint and does not change Transak, its payment methods, conversion behavior, or mint fulfillment.
The source does not change email delivery, message contents, or notification behavior.
